title: Demo: Children Travel Documents (Synthetic)
disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DEMO CONTENT — not real operator policy.
content: For this demo voyage planning assistant, children traveling on a Caribbean cruise must have an acceptable proof-of-identity document. Acceptable documents include a valid passport or, for closed-loop sailings departing from the same U.S. port, a government-issued birth certificate plus a photo ID for the accompanying adult. All minors must appear on the same reservation as their parent or legal guardian. The cruise line may require additional documentation for international ports; guests should verify requirements before sailing. This is synthetic approved demo content for policy retrieval testing only.
